name: Garlic Butter Steak

ingredients.item: ribeye or New York strip steaks (1-inch thick)

instructions: Take steaks out of fridge 30 minutes before cooking. Pat dry.
Season very generously with salt and pepper on both sides.
Heat oil in a cast iron skillet over high heat until smoking.
Sear steaks 3-4 minutes without moving. Flip and cook 3 more minutes.
Reduce heat to medium. Add butter, garlic, and herbs to pan.
Tilt pan and spoon melted butter over steaks continuously for 2 minutes.

substitutions.dairy_free: Use dairy-free butter or skip basting.
substitutions.low_carb: Already low-carb — serve with roasted vegetables.

notes: Do not skip the resting step. Slicing too early loses all the juices.
